description: Groups site names by their registrable domain, at read time; no stored name is ever altered. One provider is active at a time; with none, no grouping is offered.

cadences.basis: publicsuffix.org asks that an application download the list "no more than once per day" (publicsuffix.org/list/), and a check that finds the list unchanged costs a conditional request answered 304 with no body.

functions.description: Called at start and after every refresh: whether a list is held.
functions.name: status

functions.description: Called at refresh_interval_public_suffix_list_seconds: acquire or update the list.
functions.name: refresh

functions.description: Called while a widget is served, with the site names to group.
functions.name: group

fields.description: The `result` record; its probe is a word naming what the last refresh found.
fields.name: result

fields.description: The list's own version, when it carries one.
fields.name: version

fields.description: How many rules the list holds.
fields.name: rules

fields.description: The last instant a refresh confirmed the list current.
fields.name: confirmed_at

fields.description: Whether this refresh failed, which the core records as a collection gap from confirmed_at.
fields.name: failed

fields.description: Why the refresh failed, when it did.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Why the grouping failed, when it did.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Its registrable domain; absent when the name has none, which groups it on its own.
fields.name: registrable_domain
